messages.subject: using functions from atomic_math.hpp
parts:
Hello, 
I've been struggling quite a bit trying to use the 
D_incpl_gamma_shape()
function, receiving compilation errors such as :

"
no matching function for call to ‘D_incpl_gamma_shape(tmbutils::vector
<CppAD::AD<CppAD::AD<CppAD::AD<double> > > >&)’
"

Apologies if this is a stupid question, I am very new to C++.. I am getting  the "no matching function..." error regardless of whether I have the cppAD:: and atomic:: prefixes.  

#include <TMB.hpp>


template <class Type>
Type objective_function <Type>:: operator () ()
{

  DATA_VECTOR (betaij);
  DATA_VECTOR (sij2);
  DATA_VECTOR (pij);
 
  PARAMETER (logtheta); 
  PARAMETER_VECTOR (pu);
  PARAMETER_VECTOR (pl);
  Type theta=exp(logtheta);

 
 Type nll=0; 
 cppAD::vector<Type> pl(4);
   pl[0]=theta;
   pl[1]=Type(1.5);
   pl[2]=Type(0);
   pl[3]=Type(0);
cppAD::vector<Type> pu(4);
   pu[0]=Type(1.0);
   pu[1]=Type(1.5);
   pu[2]=Type(0);
   pu[3]=Type(0);
  
  
 
  for(int j=0; j< pij.size(); j++) {
    nll -= 
      pij(j) * (
     -log(theta - 1) - Type(0.5)*sij2(j) - 
       log(pow(betaij(j)/sij2(j),-1.5))*(atomic::D_incpl_gamma_shape(pu)[0] - 
       atomic::D_incpl_gamma_shape(pl)[0])
    );
  }
  return nll;
}

Any idea where I may be going wrong?  Thank you in advance for any help or advice.

messages.author: 90b303eef43fd993
messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] using functions from atomic_math.hpp
parts:
Your example works for me with minor modifications:


- cppAD should be CppAD

- Remove PARAMETER_VECTOR(pu) and PARAMETER_VECTOR(pl) because otherwise you declare pl and pu twice.
